content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the TISS Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor posts is 24th October 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Tata Institute of Social Sciences has announced a total of 9 vacancies for the positions of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor across various campuses and disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: For Assistant Professor positions, candidates need a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant discipline, along with qualifying NET/SLET/SET or holding a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations 2018.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 2000 for the TISS recruitment drive. SC/ST candidates have a fee of Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the recruited candidates will be based on the Academic Pay Level 10 for Assistant Professors, Academic Pay Level 13A for Associate Professors, and Academic Pay Level 14 for Professors, as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q6. Which mode of application is accepted by TISS?
faq.answer: Applications for the TISS Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor posts must be submitted exclusively through the online mode. No other application method will be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation rules for reserved categories are typically mentioned in the official notification. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed advertisement for specific information on age relaxations.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TISS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor positions at TISS will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Maharashtra apply?
faq.answer: The notification mentions Maharashtra as the state for recruitment, but the specific campuses are in Tuljapur, Hyderabad, and Guwahati. Candidates from any location meeting the eligibility criteria can apply for the respective campus positions.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF for TISS Recruitment 2026 can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
